title: DSH plugin manifest (dsh field)
description: Capability-first manifest for a DSH plugin. The platform reads capabilities from an enabled plugin; tools are implementation bindings. Legacy prompts/tools entries are accepted for migration only.

pluginApi.description: Contract version. 1.0 is legacy tool-first; 1.1 is capability-first. The platform refuses an unsupported major version.

capabilities.description: Capabilities this plugin contributes. Required by v1.1; legacy plugins may omit it temporarily.

prompts.description: Legacy plugin-level prompts. New plugins put prompts inside a capability.

skills.description: Skill files relative to the plugin root.

tools.description: Legacy tool declarations. New plugins use capability.bind.

delivery.description: Plugin-level delivery defaults; a capability may narrow this.

permissions.description: Plugin-level default permissions; a capability may narrow this.
